after2_start.name: Me
after2_start.text:
*After school. Two notifications on my phone.*

Dain: Come to the gym!! Today it's for real!!
Seoyeon: Can you come to the student council room? We're short-handed.

*Nothing from Yuna. — That's Yuna. But while packing my bag, the morning note falls out of my pocket. The words 'library annex' catch my eye.*

after2_dain_1.name: Me
after2_dain_1.text: *The gym. Dain is doing warm-ups in front of the volleyball net.*

after2_dain_4.name: Dain
after2_dain_4.text: I got here ten minutes early!!

after2_dain_5.name: Me
after2_dain_5.text: *That means you were early, not that I'm late.*

after2_dain_6.name: Dain
after2_dain_6.text: Okay, here's the deal! Five serves — get three or more over the net and you win! If not, you're buying tteokbokki today!

after2_dain_9.name: Me
after2_dain_9.text: *I serve. — Surprisingly, the second serve goes cleanly over the net.*

after2_dain_10.name: Dain
after2_dain_10.text:
*Eyes widening* Huh? I was going to go easy on you, but I guess I can't.

*Dain lowers her stance. Her eyes have changed.*

Here I come for real!

after2_dain_11.name: Me
after2_dain_11.text:
*The rally goes back and forth. Dain's movement is — clearly not ordinary. Fast, precise, muscle memory in motion.*

*This girl is genuinely good. Not just 'likes sports' good — she moves like someone who once staked her life on it.*

*Final score: 3 to 2. I barely won.*

after2_dain_12.name: Dain
after2_dain_12.text: Aaaargh!! I lost!! — But you're pretty good?! I thought you said you don't play sports?!

after2_dain_15.name: {name}
after2_dain_15.text: I didn't trick you — you just never asked.

after2_dain_16.name: Dain
after2_dain_16.text: *Punching my shoulder* You fraud!! Hahaha — but that was fun!

after2_dain_end.name: Me
after2_dain_end.text:
*Her eyes are half-moon shaped. Same eyes as yesterday. — That's how this person looks when she's genuinely having fun.*

*At the tteokbokki place near school.*

*Dain blows on her tteokbokki and says —*

after2_dain_end_2.name: Dain
after2_dain_end_2.text: Hey, you actually know sports, don't you?

after2_dain_end_2c.name: Dain
after2_dain_end_2c.text: A 'little' doesn't play like that! — Just admit it, you're good.

after2_dain_end_3.name: Me
after2_dain_end_3.text: *Dain pauses her chopsticks. Just for a moment.*

after2_dain_end_3b.name: Dain
after2_dain_end_3b.text: ...Obviously! I was a sports scholarship student, you know!

after2_dain_end_3c.name: Me
after2_dain_end_3c.text: *'Was.' Past tense. — Something tells me it's better not to ask.*

after2_dain_end_3d.name: Dain
after2_dain_end_3d.text: Ahh it's so spicy!! Water, water!!

after2_dain_end_3e.name: Me
after2_dain_end_3e.text: *The topic changed. — Whether she changed it on purpose or it was actually spicy. Probably both.*

after2_seo_1.name: Me
after2_seo_1.text: *The student council room. Seoyeon sits behind a pile of documents. Alone.*

after2_seo_2.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_2.text: You actually came. — Honestly, I didn't think you would.

after2_seo_3.name: {name}
after2_seo_3.text: I show up when I'm called.

after2_seo_5.name: {name}
after2_seo_5.text: You're the one who asked for help.

after2_seo_6.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_6.text: I didn't ask — I gave you an opportunity.

after2_seo_7.name: Me
after2_seo_7.text:
*The word 'ask' seems to not exist in this person's vocabulary.*

*I start sorting documents. Event budgets, club applications. There's quite a lot.*

after2_seo_8.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_8.text: These go by date, those by club. — Are you any good at organizing?

after2_seo_8a2.name: {name}
after2_seo_8a2.text: Not great, but not bad either.

after2_seo_8a4.name: {name}
after2_seo_8a4.text: Kind of like your compliments. You're vague about those too.

after2_seo_choice1.name: Me
after2_seo_choice1.text:
*Calling it a compliment outright. — That seems rare for someone like her.*

*While organizing, Seoyeon rolls her neck. Looks stiff.*
choices: The sunset is beautiful. — Oh, I meant outside, not you.
Is your neck sore? Take a break.

after2_seo_sunset_joke.name: Me
after2_seo_sunset_joke.text: *Seoyeon pauses for a moment. And then — she laughs. Not just her lips, but her eyes. A smile I've never seen before.*

after2_seo_sunset_react.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_sunset_react.text:
...You're the first person to say something that corny so naturally.

*Her eyes smiled. — Not the practiced smile where only the corners of her mouth rise, but a real one. Lasting more than three seconds, not just half a second.*

after2_seo_neck_worry.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_neck_worry.text: I'm fine. This is an everyday thing.

after2_seo_neck_react.name: Me
after2_seo_neck_react.text: *Seoyeon rolls her shoulders. I hear them crack.*

after2_seo_neck_touch.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_neck_touch.text:
It's really stiff. Hold still for a sec.

*Seoyeon gets up and comes behind me. She places her hands on my shoulders.*

after2_seo_neck_high.name: Me
after2_seo_neck_high.text: *I close my eyes and lean into it.*

after2_seo_neck_high_2.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_neck_high_2.text:
*Seoyeon leans on my shoulder.* ...Stay still. Just for a bit.

*She's the one who leaned on me, saying her neck hurt — but I'm the one who's nervous.*

after2_seo_neck_low.name: Me
after2_seo_neck_low.text:
*I pull back slightly.*

What are you doing all of a sudden.

after2_seo_neck_low_2.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_neck_low_2.text:
*Pulling her hands back* ...It's nothing.

*Her expression freezes for half a second. -- Then she smiles right away. Perfectly.*

after2_seo_9.name: Me
after2_seo_9.text: *The sunset washes over the student council room. The paperwork is almost done.*

after2_seo_choice2.name: Me
choices: Should I stay a bit longer? Seems like there's still some left
If we're done, I'll head out

after2_seo_stay.name: Me
after2_seo_stay.text: *Seoyeon sets the documents down and gazes out the window. The sunset light touches her face.*

after2_seo_stay_2.name: Seoyeon
after2_seo_stay_2.text: ...I like this time. When I'm alone in the student council room, I don't have to play any role.

after2_seo_stay_3.name: {name}
after2_seo_stay_3.text: Even the student council president gets to rest?

after2_seo_stay_3c.name: Me
after2_seo_stay_3c.text: *'Except here.' — Whether it's the rooftop or the student council room, Seoyeon is someone who needs a place where she can take off the mask.*

after2_seo_end.name: Me
after2_seo_end.text: *I step out of the student council room. The sunset paints the hallway.*

after2_yuna_1.name: Me
after2_yuna_1.text:
*There was no message from Yuna. But my feet are heading toward the library. Why? — I'm not sure. Maybe because of the morning note.*

*The annex hallway. Not a soul around. — The door to the secret reading room is slightly ajar.*

after2_yuna_2.name: Me
after2_yuna_2.text:
*I slip in quietly. Yuna is on the sofa, reading. The sunset is streaming through the window.*

*Yuna looks up. She's not surprised.*

after2_yuna_5.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_5.text: Do I have to call you for you to come?

after2_yuna_6.name: Me
after2_yuna_6.text: *A subtly loaded question. — But there's a hint that she was waiting.*

after2_yuna_8b.name: Me
after2_yuna_8b.text:
*A door open by coincidence. — Yuna's 'by coincidence' is synonymous with 'on purpose.'*

*I sit beside her. Yuna hands me one of her earbuds.*

after2_yuna_8d.name: Me
after2_yuna_8d.text: *A quiet piano piece begins to play. The sunset is painting the room.*

after2_yuna_9.name: Me
after2_yuna_9.text: *Yuna reads her book, and I listen to the music. No words. — Not uncomfortable at all.*

after2_yuna_choice_pre1.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_choice_pre1.text: *After a long while* ...Someone who comes here after school.

after2_yuna_choice_pre3.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_choice_pre3.text: There hasn't been one since that sunbae.

after2_yuna_choice.name: Me
after2_yuna_choice.text: *Yuna said two sentences. — For her, that's the same as 'thank you.'*

after2_yuna_everyday_react.name: Yuna
after2_yuna_everyday_react.text:
...Come if you want. I won't stop you.

*'I won't stop you.' — In Yuna's language, that translates to 'please come.'*

after2_yuna_quiet_react.name: Me
after2_yuna_quiet_react.text:
*Yuna's lips curve upward ever so slightly.*

*Yuna's smile is a rare species. Not many people have witnessed it.*

after2_yuna_end.name: Me
after2_yuna_end.text: *The sunset is fading. Sitting side by side with Yuna, listening to music. A moment where no words are needed.*

after2_dain_freetalk.name: Dain
after2_dain_freetalk.context: Day 2 afterschool, came to tteokbokki shop after a volleyball bet at the gym. Getting closer. Tone: Feeling closer than yesterday. Banter feels natural and comfortable. Push-pull flirting. No heavy topics yet.
after2_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is an energetic athlete. Competitive and straightforward, but exclamation marks disappear when she's being genuine.

hidden_nurse_d2_1.name: Me
hidden_nurse_d2_1.text: *Scraped my elbow during PE. Nothing major, but it's bleeding a little.*

hidden_nurse_d2_2.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_2.text: Oh, yesterday's transfer student. Back already? Trying to become a regular?

hidden_nurse_d2_5.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_5.text: Here... like this... there, done. It's all about care. Slap it on carelessly and it'll peel off.

hidden_nurse_d2_choice1.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_choice1.text: *Her hands are close, applying the bandage.*
choices: All that care for one little bandage

hidden_nurse_d2_choice1_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_choice1_b.text: I'm a pro~ Slacking off would be an insult to the bandage.

hidden_nurse_d2_6.name: Me
hidden_nurse_d2_6.text: *Checking the bandage when — her laptop is open on the desk. That's not a medical record — looks more like a personal diary.*

hidden_nurse_d2_7.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_7.text: You didn't see that, right? Secret~ Even teachers have secrets.

hidden_nurse_d2_choice2.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d2_choice2.text: *She says it's a secret, laughing — but her eyes aren't laughing.*
choices: You sure have a lot of secrets. Can't you tell me just one?

hidden_nurse_d2_choice2_a.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_choice2_a.text: Just one? — Hmm, you'd have to visit a lot more to earn that~

hidden_nurse_d2_choice2_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_choice2_b.text: Good kid. But you're the type who can't lie, aren't you.

hidden_nurse_d2_8.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_8.text: All done, get back to class. — Next time, come without an injury.

hidden_nurse_d2_9.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_9.text: You can come even without a reason. — Well, not during class~! After school!

hidden_nurse_d2_freetalk.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d2_freetalk.text: *Chatting with the school nurse in the nurse's office.*
hidden_nurse_d2_freetalk.context: Day 2. Scraped elbow during PE, came to the nurse's office. The nurse carefully applied a bandage. Tone: Feeling closer than yesterday. Banter feels natural and comfortable. Push-pull flirting. No heavy topics yet.
hidden_nurse_d2_freetalk.personality: The school nurse is playful but meticulous. Takes a long time applying bandages. Hiding something personal.

minsu_warn_1.name: Me
minsu_warn_1.text: *Walking home. Just past the school gate when — Minsu falls in step behind me.*

minsu_warn_6.name: Minsu
minsu_warn_6.text: Seoyeon, Dain, Yuna. All three of them smile at you.

minsu_warn_8.name: Minsu
minsu_warn_8.text: Dude, I've been in this class for a year. None of them are usually like that. Seoyeon never talks to guys first. Dain doesn't act that way with just anyone. And Yuna — she barely talks at all.

minsu_warn_9.name: Minsu
minsu_warn_9.text: All three of them only do that with you. — You know that already.

minsu_warn_10.name: Me
minsu_warn_10.text: *I know. I've just been pretending not to.*

minsu_warn_11.name: Minsu
minsu_warn_11.text: The problem is you're smiling back at all three of them the same way.

minsu_warn_12.name: Me
minsu_warn_12.text: *I have nothing to say. Minsu's right. — I pride myself on reading people, but I couldn't see the mixed signals I've been sending.*

minsu_warn_13.name: Minsu
minsu_warn_13.text: Were you like this at your old school too?

minsu_warn_14.name: Me
minsu_warn_14.text:
*— My feet stopped dead.*

*Old school. — That word hits hard. At my old school, I couldn't say anything to anyone and lived with regret. This time — I'm talking to everyone, but is that actually worse?*

minsu_warn_15.name: Minsu
minsu_warn_15.text: I don't know, maybe I'm overstepping. — But if all three of them end up crying, that's on you. For real.

minsu_warn_11c.name: Minsu
minsu_warn_11c.text: Just? That 'just' is the cruelest part. To them, it's not 'just' anything.

after2_dain_skinship_3.name: Me
after2_dain_skinship_3.text: *She pulled her hand away. Doesn't look sorry at all. — My palm is still warm.*

after2_seo_skinship_1.name: Me
after2_seo_skinship_1.text: *Seoyeon reaches out. Picks off a speck of dust from my collar. Her hand grazes my neck.*

after2_seo_skinship_2.name: Me
after2_seo_skinship_2.text: *Seoyeon's fingers pause for half a second. She turns away without a word.*

after2_yuna_skinship_1.name: Me
after2_yuna_skinship_1.text: *We reached for the same book — our hands overlap.*

after2_yuna_skinship_2.name: Me
after2_yuna_skinship_2.text: *Yuna doesn't pull away first. Three seconds. She lowers her gaze.*

after2_yuna_skinship_3.name: Me
after2_yuna_skinship_3.text: *Hands separate. Yuna picks up the book and hands it over. Without a word.*

after2_dain_11b.name: {name}
after2_dain_11b.text: *We left the gym and walked down the street.*
